newsitem.title: USA: May Census data supportive to soy, meal futures.
newsitem.headline: May Census data supportive to soy, meal futures.

text.p: Census Bureau's May crush report was viewed as supportive to CBOT soybean and soymeal futures and bearish for soyoil, traders said.
"The crush was above and meal stocks were below guesses so if anything it's supportive," a trader said.
Census Tuesday said the U.S. soybean crush in May totaled 110.712 million bushels, above an average industry estimate for 109.9 million bushels.
Soymeal stocks, including millfeeds, totaled 256,527 tons, well below an average estimate for 315,250 tons. Soyoil stocks at 2.143 billion lbs were above the average 2.112 billion.
